NEW BUSINESS

F.
Approving and Awarding a Professional Maintenance Services Agreement to SCA of CA, LLC for Citywide Street Sweeping Services - That the City Council adopt Resolution 7833: 1. Approving and awarding a Professional Maintenance Services Agreement to SCA of CA, LLC (SCA) for Citywide Street Sweeping Services for an annual cost of $356,745.88 for a total not-to-exceed amount of $1,070,237.64 for the original three (3)-year term, pursuant to the Cooperative Purchase Contract with Sourcewell, master contract #111125-SWEP, in accordance with the cooperative purchasing procedures set forth in Seal Beach Municipal Code Section 3.20.025(D); and,  2. Authorizing and directing the City Manager, to execute a Professional Maintenance Services Agreement with SCA on behalf of the City; and, 3. Authorizing the City Manager, or his designee, the option to extend the Agreement up to two (2) additional one-year terms after its original term for a not-to-exceed amount of $356,745.88 per additional term.
